newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Sept department store sales rise on month.
newsitem.headline: Canada Sept department store sales rise on month.

text.p: Canadian department stores sales rose a seasonally adjusted 0.2 percent in September from August to C$1.22 billion, Statistics Canada said on Wednesday.
In unadjusted data, year-over-year sales in September rose 0.9 percent to C$1.13 billion.
Sales at major stores fell 2.3 percent in September from the same month a year earlier to C$530.8 million.
Consumer spending in the discount stores rose 4.0 percent to C$597.9 million from the same month a year earlier.
Department store sales rose 3.3 percent in the first nine months of 1996 from the same period in 1995.
(For more information from Statistics Canada, contact Mary Beth Garneau, Retail Trade Section, Industry Division, 613-951-9824.)
